title: Chunks serialize the concatenated formula
statement: Let $R$ be a natural number and let $G$ assign a CNF formula over natural-number variables to each natural-number index. Concatenating the chunks at indices $0,\ldots,R$ gives the full serialization of the concatenation of the formulas $G(0),\ldots,G(R)$.
hypotheses_covered: A family $G$ of CNF formulas indexed by natural numbers
replaced: Let $R$ be the last round index and let a family assign a clause group to each round. The concatenation of the chunks of rounds $0,\dots,R$ equals the full serialization of the concatenation of all $R+1$ groups, formula terminator included. The identity concerns output words only and makes no satisfiability claim.
